title: Injective-resolution and derived connecting maps agree
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] with enough injectives, let $M$ be an object, and let $0\to A\to B\to C\to0$ be a short exact sequence, with distinguished triangle $A[0]\to B[0]\to C[0]\xrightarrow{w}A[0][1]$ of [lem-sf-derived-ses-triangle]. Define $\operatorname{Ext}^n_{\mathcal A}(M,-)$ both as the right derived functors of $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal A}(M,-)$ computed by injective resolutions [def-sp-injective-resolutions] and as $\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal A)}(M[0],-[0][n])$ [def-pc-ext]. Under the canonical comparison between these descriptions [lem-weil-pbc-ext-via-injective-resolution], the connecting morphism $\operatorname{Ext}^n_{\mathcal A}(M,C)\to\operatorname{Ext}^{n+1}_{\mathcal A}(M,A)$ in the injective-resolution long exact sequence for $\operatorname{Ext}^n_{\mathcal A}(M,-)$ is the homology connecting morphism induced by this distinguished triangle in the derived category, i.e. the connecting morphism of the long exact sequence of the homological functor $\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal A)}(M[0],-)$ [lem-sp-long-exact-of-triangle], $\xi\mapsto w[n]\circ\xi$.

source.place: Tags 05TE and 06XR: right-derived functors form the canonical delta-functor, and Ext is computed by injective resolutions and identified with derived-category morphisms

proof.text: The functor $v=\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal A}(M,-)$ is additive and left exact: additivity is pointwise, and a morphism $M\to K$ into the kernel of a map is exactly a morphism $M\to B$ whose composite to $C$ is zero. Apply [lem-sc-p1-right-derived-triangle-connecting] to this $v$ and to the triangle $A[0]\to B[0]\to C[0]\xrightarrow{w}A[0][1]$ of [lem-sf-derived-ses-triangle]: under the identifications $\theta^n_X:H^n(Rv(X[0]))\cong R^nv(X)$ of [lem-sp-derived-functor-single-identification], the horseshoe connecting map $R^nv(C)\to R^{n+1}v(A)$ (the connecting map of the injective-resolution long exact sequence for $\operatorname{Ext}^n_{\mathcal A}(M,-)$) is the homology connecting map $\delta^n$ of the distinguished triangle $Rv(A[0])\to Rv(B[0])\to Rv(C[0])\to Rv(A[0])[1]$ in $D^+(\mathrm{Ab})$.

source.place: Tags 05TE and 015B: canonical delta-functor from the derived category and its injective-resolution realization

proof.text: Apply [lem-sc-p1-rhom-hom-derived-connecting] to the distinguished triangle $A[0]\to B[0]\to C[0]\xrightarrow{w}A[0][1]$ of $D^+(\mathcal A)$: its isomorphisms $\psi^n_X:H^n(Rv(X))\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal A)}(M[0],X[n])$ carry $\delta^n$ of Step 1 to $\xi\mapsto w[n]\circ\xi$, the connecting morphism of $\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal A)}(M[0],-)$ [lem-sp-long-exact-of-triangle]. For $N\in\{A,C\}$ and an injective resolution $\varepsilon:N\to I^\bullet$ (for instance the one of the horseshoe resolution of Step 1), $\theta^n_N$ is induced by $Rv(N[0])\cong v(I^\bullet)=\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal A}(M,I^\bullet)$, and $\psi^n_{N[0]}$ sends the class of a cocycle $f:M\to I^n$ to $(\varepsilon[n])^{-1}\circ f$; by [lem-weil-pbc-ext-via-injective-resolution] this composite $\psi^n_{N[0]}\circ(\theta^n_N)^{-1}:R^nv(N)\to\operatorname{Ext}^n_{\mathcal A}(M,N)$ is exactly the canonical comparison of the statement. Composing with Step 1 gives the asserted equality of connecting morphisms.
